import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load sheets with correct headers
field = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
salary = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Clean field
# Filter transaction ID beginning FE-
field['Transaction ID'] = field['Transaction ID'].astype(str)
field = field[field['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-', na=False)]

# Normalize posting status
field['Posting Status_norm'] = field['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field = field[field['Posting Status_norm'] == 'posted']

# Normalize cost centre
field['Cost Centre_norm'] = field['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
# Amount
field['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(field['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')

# Clean salary
salary['Payroll Line ID'] = salary['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str)
salary = salary[salary['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-', na=False)]

salary['Payroll Status_norm'] = salary['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary = salary[salary['Payroll Status_norm'] == 'paid']

salary['Cost Centre_norm'] = salary['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
salary['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(salary['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')

# Lookup normalization
lookup['Cost Centre Code_norm'] = lookup['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
valid_codes = set(lookup['Cost Centre Code_norm'].dropna().unique())

print("Valid codes count:", len(valid_codes))
print("Field rows before filter:", len(field))
print("Salary rows before filter:", len(salary))

# Filter by valid cost centre
field_valid = field[field['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(valid_codes)]
salary_valid = salary[salary['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(valid_codes)]

print("Field rows after valid code:", len(field_valid))
print("Salary rows after valid code:", len(salary_valid))

field_total = field_valid['Amount (INR)'].sum(skipna=True)
salary_total = salary_valid['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum(skipna=True)
combined = field_total + salary_total

print("Field total:", field_total)
print("Salary total:", salary_total)
print("Combined:", combined)

# Also show some examples
print(field_valid[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Cost Centre_norm','Amount (INR)','Posting Status']].head())
print(salary_valid[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','Cost Centre_norm','Gross Salary (INR)','Payroll Status']].head())

salary['Cost Centre_norm'] = salary['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()

field_valid = field[field['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(valid_codes)]
salary_valid = salary[salary['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(valid_codes)]
